notes: Blocks (A): beds, sofas, dining sets, kitchen, bathroom, doors, stairs and more, drawn to the sheet's scale - the scale is read from the title block, picked, or measured
Turn, flip, resize and stretch blocks; sizes in mm or feet-inches
Hold the pen still at the end of a stroke to make it a clean line, arrow, box, circle or polygon (replaces Straighten)
The pen's side button or eraser end rubs out
Split into Files: by page ranges, every N pages, or back into the files it was combined from
Move pages to the start or end, Reduce File Size presets with sizes, and a search box for files with many layers
Drawings made here can be edited in the phone app, and the other way round
